reviews.text: My dog has been going here for 4 1/2 years. They love my dog and I love the staff. They treat my dog like family. My dog goes to daycare 5 days per week. In the morning when we leave the house I say we are going to "school" and he gets so excited. My dog will never go elsewhere!

My pup came home and couldn’t keep his eyes open, I think he had more than a great time at Danmar. We were worried at first since he was a rescue and this was our first time boarding. Based on the video they sent us he was having so much fun. The employee was so sweet and assured us he was doing fine. We will definitely be bringing him back.

Danmar is a like a second home for our puppy, since they treat him with such fantastic care! Each dog gets a lot of personalized attention and group play time.

The staff is incredibly friendly and caring, especially Kayla and Adriana who have gone above and beyond for us!

In addition to daycare and boarding they also have great grooming services. I couldn’t be happier with their services and care for my puppy!

Our experience boarding our two huskies was amazing! The staff was great with them, and we are now bringing them back for their second week long visit. Love that they send videos of the dogs playing and gave them baths before checkout! Thank you Danmar Pet Resort for taking good care of our dogs!

Our dog, Luna, has been going to Danmar for over a year. She goes to daycare multiple times a week and is boarded a few times a year. She is our EXTREMELY high energy fur baby and because of that, we struggled to find places that could handle her before discovering Danmar. BEFORE Danmar, Luna was constantly sick with parasites, passing foreign objects that no one told us she ate, was bitten at one daycare, and was "forgotten" to be fed for 24 hours. When we came to Danmar, we were at our wits end and desperate for a reliable place to bring her. Since coming to Danmar, we have had no issues. She is never sick anymore, is excited to play with her friends (human and furry), and comes home fed and tired. We are able to travel without worry and get periodic videos showing her having fun. We are able to call to check on her and know that she's in good hands. They even made her a birthday video that we absolutely loved and her portrait is in the lobby. The staff love her and she loves them.  The owner is so kind and accessible if we have questions or need something. We are genuinely grateful to the Danmar team for always taking such good care of our crazy girl. We absolutely recommend Danmar to anyone looking for a safe and caring place to bring their pups. Luna will happily make them feel right at home.

I brought my dogs to get groomed with Kayla and she did such an amazing job!! She actually cares about the doggies instead of just trying to get them in and out like the other place I used to go to! It’s also more affordable than other places which is greatly appreciated ☺️

My original review was from 5 years ago when I picked up my dad's dog from boarding.

Today, I took Gamora (a 40lb half chocolate lab/half pitt) in for her first ever daycare experience, and she had a great time! We'll be back soon.

The picture is of her about 30 minutes after we got home. She is all tuckered out. (You can see by her blurry tail that she is a HAPPY girl!)

Dogs were well taken care of and were nice and clean when I picked them up. Staff was super friendly and I will be back again.

Update the dogs have been there numerous times now and we will keep coming back. Great team and dogs come home happy and clean!
We bring our dog here every time we leave town.  He seems to love it there.  They take good care of him.  It's obvious that they love animals.

I just love this place for my dog. Everyone is very nice.  My dog hates to leave. I did check out other places but this one gave me a feeling that they all take great care for my dog. It is nice to leave town and know your pet is well taken care of it give me peace of mind.

We love Danmar! We’ve been taking our dogs here for boarding for almost 10 years. We enjoy the short video clips that are sent of our dogs playing and we appreciate that they are given exit baths. They are always well cared for by the wonderful staff and come home happy and tired!

We have boarded our 2 dogs here yearly for the past several years. Our experience has been nothing but great and exceeded all expectations. Staff would send videos periodically which was a great bonus . We have also used their daily day care a few times and it was always a great experience. Highly  recommend.

I was very nervous about boarding my dog for the first time but he had a great time here. They treated him incredibly well and made sure all of his needs were met! I will definitely keep using them in the future.

I have been taking my dog, Thorn, to Danmar off and on for a couple of years. While it is a smaller location, she absolutely loves going to see her fellow four-legged friends. The staff are extremely friendly and caring. I get a sense that they care about the dogs and enjoy seeing them every day.
